name: 败者食尘 / Loser Eat Dust
author: Codex
description: Records the initial state of every visited map node and lets you restart from any of them. v0.3.0 also intercepts combat death before the run ends and offers an immediate retry from the current node. v0.3.1 replaces an old checkpoint the first time its node is revisited after rewinding, while keeping the new room-entry snapshot immutable for later saves. Single-player only; no BaseLib or PCK.
